entry.title: Research Summary: September 24, 2026
entry.summary: This week's research centers on Hermes Agent v0.21.4, whose headline feature is a new --format stream-json CLI flag for structured streaming output — immediately actionable for anyone scripting against the CLI — landing alongside ~1,812 merged PRs, skills auto-load, and MCP discovery concurrency improvements. Two deep dives document the Hermes Claude CLI plugin: the end-to-end pipeline architecture where Hermes drives the unmodified official Claude Code CLI with exact version pins, and the auth model, where claude auth login keeps credentials entirely outside the plugin (no API keys required). Security hardening is the cross-cutting theme: per-invocation MCP session scoping in Microsoft Agent Framework 1.19.0, digest-verified skill archives, and Hermes plugin process isolation all reduce agent attack surface. For ecosystem watchers, AgentProto — a new open-source TypeScript agentic runtime — lists Hermes among its 14 supported agents, an early but notable integration signal.
